Passwords, messages and screen contents are not stored
Switchly does not store passwords, private messages, complete browser history, or the visible screen content processed by Accessibility. Accessibility events are evaluated locally for blocking.
Local by default; online services depend on the APK variant

Switchly’s blocking engine does not automatically upload profile names, app/website rules, blocked-notification contents, or detailed usage history. These can leave the device when you explicitly use cloud backup, send a support report, or export/share data.\n\nDepending on the APK variant, Google Play or Firebase services may process technical crash, integrity, authentication, purchase, and basic app/device metadata.
